_comment: What gets installed, grouped by what you actually do on this machine.
kind: plugin   enabled by writing settings.json (marketplace + enabledPlugins)
kind: craftkit same, but from this repo's own marketplace
kind: skill    cloned from upstream into ~/.claude/skills
kind: manual   printed for you to run; never executed for you
Nothing third-party is vendored here. Most of these carry no licence file,
which under copyright means the author kept every right, so the installer
clones from each upstream instead of shipping a copy.

ui.label: UI / UX and frontend design
ui.blurb: design judgement, motion, and a layout audit that fails the build

writing.label: Writing, docs and READMEs
writing.blurb: prose that does not read as machine-written

coding.label: Coding
coding.blurb: smallest thing that works, and verify before claiming done

resume.label: Résumé and job search
resume.blurb: a file an applicant tracking system can actually parse

seo.label: SEO and content strategy
seo.blurb: about 30 skills: audits, schema, SERP clustering, AI visibility

caveman.what: compressed replies; cuts filler without losing technical detail

lean-ctx.what: context runtime: compressed reads, searches and shell output
lean-ctx.why_manual: installs by piping a remote script into bash, and configures a global MCP server. That is your decision to make, not a script's.

ui-ux-pro-max.what: UI and UX reference: styles, palettes, type pairings, motion presets

ponytail.what: laziest-that-works mindset; stops over-engineering before it starts

plainspoken.what: fails the build when prose reads as machine-written

pagecheck.what: overflow, ragged lines, tiny text, tap targets, WCAG AA contrast

ats-resume.what: résumé parseability and job-description gap analysis

craft-setup.what: verify before claiming done; never commit unasked

design-taste-frontend.what: anti-slop frontend direction for landing pages and portfolios
design-taste-frontend.note: ships in a directory called taste-skill but declares name: design-taste-frontend, so it installs under the declared name

emil-motion.note: pick-ui-library, prototype and review-animations set disable-model-invocation, so they never appear in the skills listing and run only when invoked by name

karpathy-guidelines.what: surgical edits, stated assumptions, verifiable success criteria

impeccable.what: frontend interface design, critique and polish
impeccable.why_manual: its SKILL.md is generated from SKILL.src.md and still holds {{scripts_path}} placeholders, so a plain copy installs a broken skill

claude-seo.what: about 30 SEO skills: audits, schema, clustering, AI visibility
